# circleci_checkout_keys (Data Source)

Fetches checkout keys for a CircleCI project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "circleci_checkout_keys" "example" {
  project_slug = "github/my-org/my-repo"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_slug` (String) The project's slug in the format `vcs-type/org-name/repo-name`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The project slug used as the data source ID.
- `keys` (Attributes List) The project's checkout keys. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keys))

<a id="nestedatt--keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `keys`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the checkout key was created.
- `fingerprint` (String) The checkout key fingerprint.
- `preferred` (Boolean) Whether the checkout key is preferred.
- `public_key` (String) The public checkout key.
- `type` (String) The checkout key type.
